facility.name: Lotts of Learning Academy
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Skill Classes,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2024, revealed the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2024 by January 15, 2025, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: A total of seven operational staff files were review. Four of the seven operational staff do not have a valid CPR certification for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Used According to Manufacturer's Instructions: The basketball hoop was observed to be damage inside the school age playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Used According to Manufacturer's Instructions (26 TAC §746.4601(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The operation do not have complete their annual children product certification for the year of 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 12 or Fewer Children: Ratios were not maintained during the follow up inspection.  I observed 2 children under 17 months old in the infant room and 10 additional children between 2 and 3 years old in a mixed age group.     Note: It was discussed with the provider that the maximum number of children allowed is 4 children between 18 months-4 years old and 4 children who are 5 years old and up.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 12 or Fewer Children (26 TAC §746.1701)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: During the follow up inspection, supervision was not maintained in a classroom with children.    Note: A caregiver went back into the classroom during the inspection. Discussed that because a caregiver cannot see children from going to open the front door, another caregiver must step in to ensure supervision of children is maintained at all times.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For: During the follow up inspection, the director did not know the number of children present in a classroom.    Note: Caregivers must know the number of children they are responsible for at all times.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §746.1203(2))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: I observed two bottles of Lysol spray left on shelves in the classroom which were in reach of children.      Note: This was corrected during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: During the follow up there were 3 staff records that still do not contain the following training topics:    Handling, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials  Responding to Food Allergies  Emergency Preparedness  Understanding Building and Physical Premises Safety  Preventing the Spread of Communicable Diseases
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: An electrical outlet was left uncovered during the inspection.    Note: The provider corrected this during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: 3 out of 6 staff records evaluated did not contain training in the following topics:    Handling, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials  Responding to Food Allergies  Emergency Preparedness  Understanding Building and Physical Premises Safety  Preventing the Spread of Communicable Diseases
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: 1 out of 6 staff files evaluated did not contain completion of orientation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: The smoke detector and carbon monoxide detectors have not been tested within the last month.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §746.5319)

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions: The service light is on in the van to the child safety alarm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: A fire drill has not been conducte since February of 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: The diaper changing mat in the toddler room was torn and cannot be cleaned properly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: 3 out of 8 children's files evaluated were missing current immunziations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: During the inspection the lighting was too dark in the pre-kindergaten classroom during naptime. Upon entering the room children could not be seen.    Note: The provider turned a light on during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Supplies Not Expired: The alcohol wipes in the first aid kit were expired.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Supplies Not Expired (26 TAC §746.4003(b))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: Transportation training for the director and one caregiver who transports children was not completed within the evaluation period. An evaluation period between January 13, 2021 to January 13, 2022 was reviewed for the director and February 13, 2021 to February 13, 2022 for the caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: A child was observed sleeping on the wrong nap mat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: The first aid kit in the van is missing tweezers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: An 11 month old was observed in a crib with a blanket and a pacifier that included an attachment during the inspection.    Note: The provider removed the blanket and the pacifier during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: Lysol spray and wipes were observed in reach of children on a shelf in two classrooms during the inspection.    Note: The provider removed the cleaning supplies during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: Notarized affidavit was missing on one out of four staff files checked.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: One staff was missing orientation information on file out of four staff files checked.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission: Date of admission was missing on one out of four files checked. This was corrected during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §746.605(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's operational policies: There was no acknowledgement that one staff received the operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's operational policies (26 TAC §746.901(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: The director has 22 out of 30 clock hours of annual training from 8/2020 to 8/2021. Director lack 8 hours. Another caregiver had 18 out of 24 clock hours of annual training from 9/2020 to 9/2021 missing 6 hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))
